sites.env_note: dummy values only, none of them a URL (results.json embeds the pins and the report refuses to carry a URL). Found by starting the pinned image locally with no network and reading its boot guard messages: it refuses a non-loopback bind with AUTH_MODE=local-dev, wants a 64-hex ENCRYPTION_KEY (an all-zero placeholder, not a secret), and AUTH_MODE=local-jwt needs OIDC discovery over the network, so shared-hmac with a placeholder OAUTH_JWT_SECRET is used. The database is a SQLite file on a tmpfs.

sites.name: mctl-academy
sites.breakpoint_note: observed in the consumer source (client/src/components/AppNav.vue: the header carries mctl-site-header--drawer-wide and the component reads matchMedia('(min-width: 981px)')); the contract itself does not state it
sites.expected_blocked_note: stats.mctl.ai/insights.js: analytics script named in the served HTML. consumer-mctl-academy/api/auth/get-session: the client-rendered app asks its own session endpoint on every load; the guard treats /api/auth as sensitive and aborts it, so the app runs as a signed-out visitor whose session request got no answer. Both are aborted, never answered.
sites.env_note: dummy value only. The image refuses to start in production without BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and without a database it can reach over TLS; the database is the sidecar below, and DATABASE_URL is built by run.sh for it, never written here. Found by starting the pinned image locally against a Postgres container.
sites.sidecar_note: the app applies its own migrations at boot, and one of them needs the role academy_readonly to exist (in production a managed role provides it; the app's own CI creates it by hand).
sites.selectors_note: read from the consumer's header component (client/src/components/AppNav.vue), not from served HTML, because the page is a client-rendered app: burger .mctl-site-burger follows the nav in DOM order; only the top-level app-nav-link links are listed. outside is the first visible link or button in main, chosen without a keyboard walk and corrected after the first run if it is wrong.
